stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs Post $75 Million Net Inflow as Fidelity Offsets BlackRock Outflows
stories.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs took in a net $75 million on the day, CryptoSlate reports. Inflows into Fidelity's fund outweighed withdrawals from BlackRock's ETF. The split flows point to mixed investor conviction rather than one-directional demand.
stories.whyItMatters: ETF flows are a direct read on institutional demand for Bitcoin, and a split between issuers signals uneven conviction among large investors.
whatToWatch: Whether Fidelity's inflows continue or reverse
The next daily flow report for signs of a broader trend
Any change in the pace of BlackRock's outflows
questions: What drove money out of BlackRock's fund specifically?
Is this a one-day blip or the start of a trend?

stories.title: Strategy's STRC Preferred Shares Stage a Comeback, Could Fund More Bitcoin Buys
stories.summary: Strategy's $100 STRC preferred stock is drawing renewed demand, according to CryptoSlate. A sustained recovery could turn what had been a cash drain for the company into fresh capital for Bitcoin purchases. Strategy has relied on various debt and equity instruments to keep adding Bitcoin to its balance sheet.
stories.whyItMatters: Strategy is the largest corporate Bitcoin holder, so its financing capacity directly affects one of the market's biggest buyers.
whatToWatch: Whether STRC demand holds up
Any announcement of a new Bitcoin purchase tied to this funding
questions: How much new buying power would this actually unlock?
Is demand recovering because of STRC's terms or broader risk appetite?

stories.title: Bitcoin Traders Brace for $2.7 Billion Options Expiry With a Five-Hour Coverage Gap
stories.summary: A $2.7 billion Bitcoin options expiry lands Friday, CryptoSlate reports. The report flags a five-hour window around the event with notably thinner hedging or liquidity coverage than usual. Large expiries like this one can add short-term volatility as positions unwind.
stories.whyItMatters: Big options expiries can move spot prices quickly, and reduced coverage during the flagged window raises the odds of sharper swings.
whatToWatch: Price action around Friday's expiry
Whether volatility spikes during the five-hour window
questions: What exactly causes the coverage gap?
Which strike prices hold the most open interest?

stories.title: Bitcoin Falls Below $76,000 as AI Bubble Fears Erase $2.5 Trillion From Wall Street
stories.summary: Bitcoin dropped below $76,000 as broader fears about an AI stock bubble wiped roughly $2.5 trillion off Wall Street, CryptoSlate reports. The decline tracks a wider risk-off move rather than a crypto-specific trigger. Bitcoin has increasingly traded in step with tech and AI-linked equities.
stories.whyItMatters: The drop shows Bitcoin's growing correlation with AI-linked equities, meaning crypto now shares exposure to swings in that sector.
whatToWatch: Whether Bitcoin finds support or falls further
Whether the AI-stock selloff stabilizes or deepens
Bitcoin's correlation with tech equities in coming sessions
questions: Is this a temporary correlation spike or a lasting shift?
What would decouple Bitcoin from the AI equity story again?

stories.title: Circle's $182 Million Token Sale Masks a Revenue Decline as USDC Business Weakens
stories.summary: Circle raised $182 million through a crypto token sale, but CryptoSlate reports this obscures an underlying revenue decline. The stablecoin issuer's core USDC business appears to be softening even as the sale brought in fresh cash.
stories.whyItMatters: Circle's financial health matters for USDC's stability, since USDC is one of the most widely used stablecoins in crypto trading and settlement.

stories.title: Treasury's Cash Plan Hints at a Possible December Liquidity Boost for Bitcoin
stories.summary: A US Treasury cash management plan could open a liquidity window in December, with knock-on effects for Bitcoin, CryptoSlate reports. Broader dollar liquidity tends to affect risk assets, including crypto. The report gives limited detail on the mechanism and exact timing.
stories.whyItMatters: Bitcoin often tracks shifts in overall market liquidity, so a Treasury-driven cash injection could support prices heading into year-end.
whatToWatch: Treasury announcements on cash management through December
Bitcoin's price response if liquidity does loosen
questions: How direct is the link between this Treasury plan and crypto markets?

stories.title: South Korea Weighs Another Delay to Its 22% Crypto Tax, Plus New Loss Relief
stories.summary: South Korea is considering postponing its planned 22% crypto tax again, CryptoSlate reports. The proposal would also give investors a new break on losses. The tax has already faced repeated delays amid industry pushback.
stories.whyItMatters: Repeated delays show South Korean lawmakers remain unsettled on crypto tax policy, affecting one of the world's most active retail trading markets.
whatToWatch: A vote or formal decision on the delay
The new effective date if the tax is pushed back again
Details on the proposed loss-relief rules
questions: Will this delay be the last, or does it face further pushback?
How would the loss relief be calculated for investors?

stories.summary: Indian authorities have warned that hackers are using AI tools to steal crypto wallet keys, CryptoSlate reports. The warning points to growing use of AI in theft attempts against crypto holders. The report does not detail specific incidents or victim counts.
stories.whyItMatters: AI-assisted attacks on wallet security raise the stakes for anyone holding crypto directly, since stolen keys mean irreversible loss of funds.

stories.title: Riot's $28 Billion AI Data Center Lease Gives Anthropic a Say Over Power Cuts
stories.summary: Bitcoin miner Riot Platforms has signed a $28 billion AI data center lease, CryptoSlate reports. The deal gives Anthropic veto power over voluntary power curtailments at the site. Miners increasingly lease capacity to AI firms to diversify revenue beyond Bitcoin mining.
stories.whyItMatters: The deal shows major Bitcoin miners pivoting toward AI infrastructure, a shift that could reshape how mining firms use their power capacity.

questions: What happens to Riot's mining output as capacity shifts to AI hosting?
